notes: Each of the three supplied complementizers is placed on the infinitive it introduces under rule 85; giving them to the governing predicate remains defensible.
The supplied subject 'she' is placed on μέλλειν, the infinitive whose subject it is (rule 74).
κινδυνεύει → 'is there danger' is headed on 'danger' under rule 91, as at ACT.19.40.
τὸ ἱερόν is read under rule 57: the outer article governs its noun across the interposed genitive and takes 'the', while the inner article takes 'of the'.
